text: Entry 1497 sends the remote CreateFolder request and its callback creates the local folder and records the returned server ID. Current ExchangeFolder preserves that ordering: its success listener checks one ID, calls CreateNewLocalExchangeFolder, stores the Exchange ID and sends folder-added notifications. The local store operation can still fail after remote creation; this is not an atomic local/remote transaction guarantee. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: Create the local Exchange folder after remote completion, then notify consumers
